diagram.alt: Two horizontal metal plates, the upper one positive, 6.00 mm apart. A small oil drop is held still between them, with the electric force on it upwards and its weight downwards. A voltmeter is connected across the plates and a microscope looks at the drop from the side.
diagram.caption: The oil drop is held still when the electric force on it balances its weight.
